name: compare_job_posting
description: For the employer of one open US healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing posting (nurses, therapists, pharmacists, accountants, financial analysts, bankers, software engineers, data and security roles, engineers, scientists, attorneys, paralegals, recruiters, HR and marketing roles): free, the posted pay range for the role within 25 miles and how many employers are hiring it, competitors counted, not named. How fast roles like it close, where this posting's pay and time open sit against each competitor by name, how hard the role is to fill there and what reaching more applicants costs are in the Competitive Hiring Report (request_competitive_hiring_report; first report free).

arguments.name: job_url
arguments.desc: The posting's URL on the employer's careers site, or a veritahire.com/j/ URL

name: hiring_market
description: The current US hiring market for one healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing occupation, nationally or in one state: live postings, employers hiring, the posted pay range and employment type. Read from employers' own careers sites and rebuilt daily.

arguments.name: occupation
arguments.desc: A healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing occupation in plain words

arguments.name: state
arguments.desc: Two-letter US state, a state name, or US (the default)

name: request_competitive_hiring_report
description: Emails one link to the work address given. The click creates a free VeritaHire account and opens the full Competitive Hiring Report for that posting: every employer hiring the same role within 25 miles by name, with the pay each posts and how fast each closes it, the last roles like it to close nearby, competitors' pay changes, and what reaching more applicants would cost.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: The hiring manager's work email address

arguments.name: location
arguments.desc: For a role being planned: a US city and state ("Stockton, CA") or a ZIP code.

arguments.name: pay
arguments.desc: For a role being planned: the pay being considered, yearly or hourly ("95000", "$45 an hour")

name: is_job_still_open
description: Whether a job posting is still on the employer's own careers site (VeritaHire re-reads employer sites and marks a posting closed within about 36 hours of it leaving): open, closed or unknown, with the last time it was confirmed. Works for any employer's posting, given its careers-site link.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: The posting URL (careers site or veritahire.com/j/)
